name: Even Lovers Drown
source:
Even in the thoroughly modern era of the 1920s, one meets all sorts of characters while traveling the vaudeville circuit. Lark (gender selectable) has seen acts enough—and cons enough—to place very little stock in either magic or fairytales.

That is, until two beings straight from myth turn Lark's world topsy-turvy. Entangled in a selkie's daring heist and stuck ferrying a stolen siren prince back to sea, the question is no longer whether magic exists—but whether Lark can survive without it. 

Because where magic is not a mere act, forces beyond reckoning loom in the shadows, and the monsters of old are neither phony, nor dead: rather, they are much closer—and much more dangerous!—than Lark has ever dared to imagine them. 

[From [url=https://skywritestudios.itch.io/even-lovers-drown]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
即使在20年代这个彻底现代的时代，人们在巡演歌舞杂耍时也会遇到各种各样的人物。Lark（可选择性别）已经见识过足够多的行为，也见过足够多的缺点，因此对魔法或童话故事不抱什么信心。

也就是说，直到两个直接来自神话的生物将云雀的世界搅得天翻地覆。卷入了海妖的大胆抢劫，并被困在将被盗的海妖王子运送回海上的过程中，问题不再是魔法是否存在，而是云雀在没有魔法的情况下能否生存。

因为魔法不仅仅是一种行为，在阴影中隐现着难以估量的力量，而古老的怪物既不是虚假的，也不是死亡的：相反，它们比拉克敢于想象的更接近——而且更危险！

[来自[url=https://skywritestudios.itch.io/even-lovers-drown]itch.io[/url]]
